name: plantuml-markdown-preview
description: Renders ```plantuml code fences in the VS Code Markdown preview using plantuml.js (CheerpJ based, runs entirely client-side, no Java/server required).

plantumlMarkdownPreview.assetsBaseUrl.description: Base URL used to load the plantuml.js runtime assets (jar files, fonts, stdlib) served through CheerpJ. Defaults to this repository's own GitHub Pages build.

plantumlMarkdownPreview.cheerpjLoaderUrl.description: URL of the CheerpJ loader script used to run plantuml.js in the background renderer.
